title: Enhancement: Add platform support for Nexthop Systems TH5 switch
author: michaelc-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

Porting SONiC to a new Nexthop Systems device. Adding device-specific hardware drivers as well as device-specific configuration files to initialize a Nexthop TH5 based switch.

### Current Behavior

No current SONiC support exists for any Nexthop based hardware.



### Proposed Behavior

SONiC can boot and recognize a Nexthop TH5 switch. Peripheral hardware can be configured via SONiC Platform APIs.
